notes.title: Talents Digital Behind-the-scenes Book Release! 🎉
notes.content: [p align="start"]Hi everyone![/p][p align="start"]Exciting news—our [i]Talents: Behind-the-Scenes Digital Book[/i] is finally out on [b]Steam[/b]! 🎉[/p][p align="start"]This digital art/dev book is over [b]130 pages,[/b] packed with:[/p][list][*][p]Concept art and scrapped designs[/p][/*][*][p]Art, UI, and graphic design processes[/p][/*][*][p]CG Gallery w/ commentary[/p][/*][*][p]Writing and research processes[/p][/*][*][p]Game design insights[/p][/*][*][p]Voice acting process [/p][/*][*][p]Character profiles and relationship map[/p][/*][*][p]Compatibility quiz[/p][/*][*][p]Full walkthrough[/p][/*][*][p]Artists interviews[/p][/*][*][p]Dev postmortem[/p][/*][*][p]Exhibit diaries[/p][/*][*][p]Secrets from production that never saw the light[/p][/*][*][p]…and more![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We really wanted this book to feel like opening up our dev journals and letting you peek inside—the chaos, the lessons, and the love that went into making this otome. Do note that it's full of spoilers, so read at your own risk![/p][p align="start"]🎉 To celebrate launch week, it’s [b]10% OFF[/b] now on Steam![/p][p align="start"]Get it here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3966840/Talents_Digital_Behindthescenes_book/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you all so much for the support—it means the world that you’d want to see what happens behind the pixels. 💖[/p]

notes.title: Updated Streaming Guidelines
notes.content: [p][b]Updated: August 15, 2025[/b][/p][p align="start"]To protect the experience for other players, we kindly ask that streamers and content creators uploading recorded playthroughs[b] limit their coverage to the Prologue[/b], which averages around[b] 2 hours[/b] and was intentionally designed to feel like a complete experience on its own.[/p][p align="start"]To preserve the story and surprises for future players, we kindly ask that the rest of the game be played privately. Only official press and media partners of Izumi Games are currently allowed to stream or upload content beyond the prologue—with the exception of fair use coverage such as reviews or feedback, [b]as long as it doesn't include full-game streams or recorded playthroughs.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Failure to comply will result in copyright strikes.  We hope you’ll respect this as a dev’s heartfelt wish, not a rule.[/p][p align="start"]You’re still free to enjoy the full game off-stream, or encourage your viewers to try it themselves. Thanks again for helping us protect this experience. 🙏[/p][p align="start"]— Izumi[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Note:[/i][/b][i] This notice was previously shared in a devlog with an external link. We’re also uploading it here to avoid confusion and improve information dissemination.[/i][/p]

notes.title: [Devlog] Linux & Steam Deck Support Re-enabled (Unofficial)
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Just a quick update: we've re-enabled the [b]Linux + Steam Deck[/b] build for the game![/p][p]Originally, we temporarily disabled it after a player reported a crash during launch on Steam Deck. Since we don’t currently have Steam Deck hardware for testing, we wanted to prevent confusion while we looked into it.[/p][p]However, a few players kindly reached out and shared that they were able to get the game running just fine after adjusting compatibility settings (for example, using [b]Proton 5.13-6[/b] on Steam Deck). We're so grateful for your initiative and feedback—it means a lot![/p][p]So we’ve decided to make the build available again, with a small disclaimer on the store description:[/p][quote][p]⚠️ [b]Linux & Steam Deck Disclaimer[/b]
This game is not officially supported on Linux/Steam Deck, as we currently do not have the hardware to properly test or troubleshoot issues. However, some players have reported successful gameplay after adjusting compatibility settings (e.g., using Proton 5.13-6 on Steam Deck).[/p][p]We recommend trying the demo first to check compatibility. If the demo runs smoothly, the full game should work as well.[/p][/quote][p]Thank you so much for your patience and support. 💖
Your feedback truly makes a difference![/p]

notes.title: Linux Build Temporarily Removed
notes.content: [p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p]Just a quick heads-up: I've temporarily disabled the Linux version on Steam due to a reported crash on Steam Deck. While the game wasn’t intended to support Steam Deck, I accidentally left the [b]Linux + SteamOS[/b] option enabled during release, which has caused some confusion (admittedly, I got confused with its publishing configuration too, as I only meant to support desktop Linux).[/p][p]But since it's still crashing on Steam Deck (which is still a Linux-based OS), I’ve decided to disable it for now. I'm currently investigating the issue and will re-enable Linux support once it's stable. This might take a long time. In the meantime, if you're on Linux, you can still get the game on [url="https://izumi-games.itch.io/talents"]Itch.io[/url], where it's available as usual.[/p][p]If you want a refund, you may visit this [url="https://store.steampowered.com/steam_refunds/"]page [/url]for more details. If you need any assistance or have questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to me via email at [url="https://izumigames.assistance@gmail.com"]izumigames.assistance@gmail.com[/url].[/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and understanding! 💻🙇‍♀️[/p]

notes.title: 🎉Game is Out + Notes From the Dev
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! I’m incredibly excited (and nervous!) to finally release the full version of my visual novel.[/p][p]This game was developed solo, with me handling the writing, coding,  designing, marketing, and publishing. I was also blessed to collaborate with a few talented artists, animators, voice actors, and beta testers who helped bring this world to life. It’s been a journey full of bugs, breakthroughs, and a whole lot of heart.[/p][p]This game was shaped by years of travel, real interviews, and hands-on experience in development and marketing. The process itself — the people met, lessons learned, and paths taken — meant as much to me as the finished game. I hope that spirit comes through and resonates with you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s inside:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Choice-driven, writing skill-dependent gameplay with multiple endings[/p][/*][*][p]Romance, rivalries, and emotional messes[/p][/*][*][p]A stylish visual novel set in the world of game development[/p][/*][*][p]A personal, slightly chaotic love letter to creativity[/p][/*][/list][p]This project meant more to me than I can put into words. I poured everything I had into it—not just time and effort, but years of thoughts, memories, and quiet prayers.[/p][p]All glory to God in Jesus’ name. Every opportunity this game received was only possible through His hand. He guided each step, opened the right doors, and carried me through every moment I wanted to give up. By His grace alone, it came together and was brought to completion.[/p][p]To the fans and players who supported us, whether from the beginning or just recently discovering the game, thank you for helping us reach this point. Your encouragement, kind words, and belief in this little story gave it life.[/p][p]As a small thank-you to everyone supporting this release, the game is launching with a [b]10% discount[/b] for a limited time.[/p][p]For players who have played the demo before, we ask you to [b]please clear the game's data on your PC first[/b] to minimize bugs due to the new configuration (clearing the game's persistent file on your PC). For more assistance and bug reports, please email me at [url="https://izumigames.assistance@gmail.com"]izumigames.assistance@gmail.com[/url].[/p][p]Also, an important note: [b]the Mac build of the full game isn’t currently available on Steam[/b]. We’ve decided to hold off for now due to some configuration and support issues. However, you can still download the Mac version from our [url="https://izumi-games.itch.io/talents"]Itch.io page[/url]! Because of this, we'll also remove the Mac version of our demo, here on Steam.[/p][p]We've also uploaded [url="https://izumi-games.itch.io/talents/devlog/984863/streaming-guidelines-talents-launch-day-note"]streaming guidelines[/url] for anyone who wants to stream our game. They're not mandatory—just a request from me as the developer.[/p][p]If you enjoyed the game, sharing your thoughts in a review or recommending it to a friend would mean so much. Thank you again, truly, for everything.[/p][p][/p][p]—Izumi[/p]

notes.content:
[p][b]We’ve updated the [i]Talents[/i] prologue demo![/b]
This is the closest version yet to the full game.[/p][p][b]What’s new?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Revised character motivations and writing to align with the full game[/p][/*][*][p]Skip function added for Writing Skill Event QTE[/p][/*][*][p]UI updates (Major changes to the Gallery feature, Choice menus, Phone texts, Writing Skill Event QTE, Main Menu, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Content warnings added[/p][/*][*][p]New voice acting settings[/p][/*][*][p]New Dictionary feature to review previously unlocked words[/p][/*][*][p]Option to reset game data[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Proofreading fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Minor art revisions[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re getting closer to launch, and we can’t wait for you to meet your cofounders in the full game! notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[p]🎉 After more than two years in development… it’s finally here. 🎉[/p][p][b]TALENTS[/b] launches on [b]July 14, 2025 (PH timezone)[/b] on Itch and Steam![/p][p]This project has been a labor of love, and we're so excited (and nervous) to finally share it with you all.  Get ready to meet your handsome cofounders, survive relationship drama, and navigate romance in a startup workplace—all while diving into the wild world of indie game dev. 🎮💖[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who’s followed the project, shared kind words, or even just wishlisted it.[/p][p]
[b]Mark your calendars—launch day’s just around the corner![/b] 📅[/p]

notes.title: Talents Demo V.3. is LIVE!
notes.content:
The new enhanced demo is now available to play! The new version includes major changes such as:

•	Recolored CG Illustrations
•	Enhanced Background Images
•	New Voice Lines, Character, and Script Changes, relevant to the full game
•	Call & Text Features for more Immersive Gameplay
•	In-Game Social Media Comments
•	Added Tutorial
•	Game Cameos
•	New Opening Video
•	Added Relevant Sites on Main Menu

We uploaded this 2 days early due to an emergency. As this is still a demo, we deeply value your review to help us improve and move closer to completion. If you’d like to support the project, we gladly accept donations through [url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/talents/devlog/857508/donation-perks]Itch.io[/url] or [url=https://ko-fi.com/izumigames]Ko-fi[/url], which will directly contribute to polishing the game and addressing blockers along the way.

Since the game is entirely self-funded by Izumi, the solo developer, challenges like health issues, emergencies, currency fluctuations, inflation, or even unforeseen setbacks (e.g., a hard drive failure, drawing tablet breaking) can sometimes delay progress. Especially since these blockers were out of her budget, and now her only laptop is experiencing issues again which is now causing setbacks on development. Your support helps us overcome these hurdles and fund essential aspects of the game, such as art and voice acting, since we commission people for those assets. In return, certain rewards are set. Go to this [url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/talents/devlog/857508/donation-perks]link [/url]for more details.

To celebrate the new demo update, a new game trailer and opening video is also available at the game page.

Thank you and we hope you enjoy playing the updated demo!

Don’t forget to follow us or Wishlist the game to immediately get an email when the full game is out. You can also follow us on any of our social media accounts for further announcements.

Until then~!

- Izumi
